# Mail Technician
1. Your direct superior is the Quartermaster.
2. Mail Technicians are to turn the Mail Teleporter off when not in active use.
3. Mail Technicians are to prioritize the delivery of urgent, time sensitive packages.
4. Mail Technicians must inform people when they’re delivering them harmful packages, like bomb letters, so they can open with the Security Team.
5. First attempts at mail delivery should be to the person themselves. If unreachable, Mail Technicians are leave it at their department. Assistants or other unemployed crew can have their mail left on a table at the bar.
6. Mail Technicians are to remind the crew that their mail is required to be opened, lest they receive legal repercussions from the Command team.
